finalResponses:
Use **`poteto-help` for guidance** and **`poteto-mode` to route an engineering task**. Choose a specific entry when the intended outcome is clear.

Each link below points to its installed instructions.

| Common request | OMS entry |
|---|---|
| Explain OMS setup or workflow choices | [poteto-help](<INSTALLED_PLUGIN>/skills/poteto-help/SKILL.md) |
| Pick the workflow for an execution request | [poteto-mode](<INSTALLED_PLUGIN>/skills/poteto-mode/SKILL.md) |
| Answer an engineering question without changes | [investigation](<INSTALLED_PLUGIN>/skills/investigation/SKILL.md) |
| Explain how code works / why a design exists | [how](<INSTALLED_PLUGIN>/skills/how/SKILL.md) / [why](<INSTALLED_PLUGIN>/skills/why/SKILL.md) |
| Reproduce and fix defective behavior | [bug-fix](<INSTALLED_PLUGIN>/skills/bug-fix/SKILL.md) |
| Add or intentionally change behavior | [feature](<INSTALLED_PLUGIN>/skills/feature/SKILL.md) |
| Improve structure while preserving behavior | [refactoring](<INSTALLED_PLUGIN>/skills/refactoring/SKILL.md) |
| Design interfaces and module boundaries | [architect](<INSTALLED_PLUGIN>/skills/architect/SKILL.md) |
| Test alternatives with a throwaway experiment | [prototype](<INSTALLED_PLUGIN>/skills/prototype/SKILL.md) |
| Produce a dependency plan without executing it | [multi-phase-plan](<INSTALLED_PLUGIN>/skills/multi-phase-plan/SKILL.md) |
| Challenge a bounded change or design; return a review | [interrogate](<INSTALLED_PLUGIN>/skills/interrogate/SKILL.md) |
| Fix measured slowness / validate a performance claim | [perf-issue](<INSTALLED_PLUGIN>/skills/perf-issue/SKILL.md) / [benchmark-checklist](<INSTALLED_PLUGIN>/skills/benchmark-checklist/SKILL.md) |
| Prevent recurring repository mistakes structurally | [correct](<INSTALLED_PLUGIN>/skills/correct/SKILL.md) |
| Review conversation lessons for Skill improvements | [reflect](<INSTALLED_PLUGIN>/skills/reflect/SKILL.md) |
| Check or make an existing PR merge-ready | [babysit](<INSTALLED_PLUGIN>/skills/babysit/SKILL.md); capability limits apply, and merging needs separate authorization |
| Explicitly land an existing PR or stack | [shipping](<INSTALLED_PLUGIN>/skills/shipping/SKILL.md) |

[`oms-auto`](<INSTALLED_PLUGIN>/skills/oms-auto/SKILL.md) is optional automatic routing, enabled only after its status check. An explicitly selected Skill takes precedence.

Use the host’s supported Skill picker or invocation mechanism; plain-text names do not necessarily select a Skill. After selecting `poteto-mode`, one usable prompt is:

> Reproduce [failure] using [steps], fix its cause, and show the passing user flow plus a check that detects the original failure. Keep changes within [scope]. Do not publish.

Verified against the installed [catalog](<INSTALLED_PLUGIN>/SKILL_CATALOG.json) and owning files. I did not inspect or change this project, spawn agents, or publish anything.

limits: Startup inventory preceded status; workflow reads followed status
Explicit help reads catalog and workflow documentation; no project inspection or engineering execution
No published release or personal OMS upgrade
